The people behind it

Meet the Organizers

Three neighbors who believed a shared table could change the feeling of a block.

Our story

Started with one potluck that wouldn't end

In 2021, Rosa Figueroa set up a folding table in front of her apartment and invited the block to share a meal. Fourteen people showed up. Then twenty. Then neighbors started bringing neighbors who didn't know anyone yet.

Declan Walsh brought his heirloom tomatoes. Priya Nakamura brought Their Eyes Were Watching God and suggested they read it together next month. Common Table had already started — it just didn't have a name.

  • We believe the neighborhood already has everything it needs — the skills, the food, the wisdom — it just needs a table to gather around.
  • Every gathering is member-led. We are not a service. We are a community.
  • No experience required. First-timers and long-timers share the same chair.
Join the Table
The core three

Who keeps the lights on

Rosa Figueroa

Co-Founder & Potluck Lead

Rosa grew up cooking for a large family in Oaxaca and moved to the Portsmith District eight years ago after landing a job teaching art at Garfield Middle School. She started Common Table in 2021 by dragging a folding table out of her apartment and chalking "Bring a dish, stay awhile" on the sidewalk. She wasn't sure anyone would come. Fourteen people did, and things have never really stopped since.

Rosa leads the potluck series and the skill-share kitchen sessions. Her sourdough starter is named Gerald and is four years old.

Declan Walsh

Co-Founder & Garden Lead

Declan spent thirty years as a city planner before retiring to what he describes as "full-time gardening with light bureaucracy on the side." He keeps three raised beds on his back patio, tends a dwarf apple orchard, and has more seeds than he will ever have time to plant. The seed library was his idea and remains his proudest contribution to Common Table.

He organizes the garden walks, coordinates the volunteer days, and is reliably the person who shows up an hour early to move the furniture.

Priya Nakamura

Reading & Programs Lead

Priya is a reference librarian at the Portsmith Branch by day and an enthusiastic book evangelist the rest of the time. She joined Common Table as a volunteer two years ago, after attending four reading circles in a row and realizing she had opinions about the facilitation. She took over the reading program the following month. The quality of the discussions improved immediately.

She lives with her partner Kenji and their two cats, Miso and Nori. She is the person who will remember your name and the title of the book you mentioned offhand six months ago.

Questions? Ideas? A dish to share?

Rosa, Declan, and Priya are all reachable via email and love hearing from neighbors.
